fixture_name: McGrath Hwy (Rte 28) @ Mystic Ave/Broadway — real US design-stage RSA (MassDOT/HNTB)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Dysfunctional pedestrian signals at a high-volume urban arterial crossing create genuine wrong-information/absent-guidance risk for pedestrians, a substantive safety issue appropriate to raise at preliminary design stage.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Verbatim quote EV-US-034 ('Investigate and fix existing dysfunctional pedestrian signals.') directly records the pivotal deficiency, tied via the finding to the McGrath Highway/Broadway safety-issue table.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a categorical safety_concern about pedestrian guidance reliability, with no conflation into MUTCD compliance assertions and no invented normative basis.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Actionable and viable within the current design stage—identify, investigate, and repair the deficient pedestrian indications—though modest in added specificity beyond the source item.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians—the relevant VRU group—are explicitly the affected road user class and the exposure scenario centers on their reliance on the displays.

justifications.substance: Concrete accessibility-compliance substance covering named pedestrian elements (crosswalks, refuge islands, detectable warnings, APS, countdown signals) at defined intersections under mandatory AAB/ADA instruments.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim is anchored by registry-id EV-US-035 plus a matching verbatim quote of the enhancement-list entry, satisfying the quote requirement for a 2.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly typed as a compliance_question with categorical separation asserted from safety judgment and null risk components, consistent with FHWA RSA framing of normative conformance items.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and viable at preliminary design—conform all crossings across the enumerated elements within the current design—though it closely mirrors the source entry.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians are the sole affected road user class and their accessibility needs are fully addressed by the finding's scope.
